description: Implementation of the DisplayNULL class for a null renderer in ANGLE, providing stubbed or default behaviors for graphics display and context management.

classes.name: DisplayNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of the Display interface for offscreen or dummy rendering.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display, setting up an allocation tracker.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the display and resets the allocation tracker.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Makes the specified surfaces and context current; stubbed to always succeed.

methods.name: generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates a default set of EGL configurations.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the device is lost; always returns false.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Restores a lost device; stubbed to always succeed.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window is valid; always returns true.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns the vendor string 'NULL'.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new DeviceNULL instance.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Waits for client operations; stubbed to succeed immediately.

methods.name: waitNative
methods.description: Waits for native operations; stubbed to succeed immediately.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported OpenGL ES version (3.2).

methods.name: getMaxConformantESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum conformant ES version, same as supported version.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface, returns a new SurfaceNULL.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pbuffer surface, returns a new SurfaceNULL.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a pbuffer from a client buffer, returns a new SurfaceNULL.

methods.name: createPixmapSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixmap surface, returns a new SurfaceNULL.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an image, returns a new ImageNULL.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a null graphics context, returns a new ContextNULL.

methods.name: createStreamProducerD3DTexture
methods.description: Creates a stream producer for D3D textures; unimplemented, returns nullptr.

methods.name: generateExtensions
methods.description: Populates extension support flags with true values.

methods.name: generateCaps
methods.description: Sets caps indicating NPOT textures are supported.
